thread:
maria: quick ping — opened PR for onboarding velvet-13b-quant tokenizer + quant profile, can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/812 I've run unit tests locally but CI has one flaky failure

jason: on it, sending a quick repro pass. can you paste the failing test output?

maria: sure — job `tokenizer-compat` fails with: `ValueError: Unexpected token id 0 at offset 12` — looks like vocab mismatch on a small subset. PR updates `vocab.json` and adds a quant profile under `profiles/velvet-13b/quant.yaml`

lee: I'll take a look after standup. if it's vocab we should bump the tokenizer version and add a regression sample in `tests/data/velvet-sample.txt`

simon: CI logs show the failure only on py3.9 matrix. might be numpy differences. suggestion: pin numpy in the test matrix or add a deterministic seed for byte-pair merges

maria: i tried pinning numpy locally (`numpy==1.25.2`) and still saw the mismatch; sharing the small smoke script I used: ```python
# tests/smoke_tokenizer.py
from velvet_tokenizer import VelvetTokenizer
t = VelvetTokenizer('models/velvet-13b/vocab.json')
print(t.encode('The quick brown fox'))
```

ci-bot: CI status: build #3421 — tokenizer-compat FAILED (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/3421/log)

jason: :eyes: will reproduce in a container, if it's a seed issue i'll try setting `RNG_SEED=42` and rerunning the tokenization tests

lee: small operational note — prefer merging this before tomorrow EOD (we have a rollout window for new models). if we can't get CI green, add a fallback model alias in serving config so production can still use the previous quant build

maria: good call — added fallback alias `velvet-13b-quant-v0` in `configs/models.yaml` and a short changelog entry in the PR. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/812/files

simon: skimmed the config diffs, LGTM for the serving alias. one tiny nit in the quant profile docstring (typo: "quantizaton" -> "quantization"). otherwise looks fine. approving config change portion

jason: left an inline comment asking to set RNG seed in the smoke test. once CI green i'll approve the tokenizer code. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — I pushed the smoke test update and the docstring fix. re-ran CI, currently queued

ci-bot: CI status: build #3423 — all checks passed ✅ (tokenizer-compat, unit, smoke)

jason: LGTM, approving now. merging after a 5-minute guard window to watch for any immediate issues

maria: merging now. tagging @oncall to watch the rollout window and feature flag: `velvet-13b-quant` will be behind `ff/velvet-quant-rollout` for 24h

lee: thanks team — nice fast turnaround. if anything odd shows up, revert plan is to toggle the alias back to `velvet-13b-quant-prev` and open a patch

simon: noted. good job getting the fallback in place.

maria: closing the loop — merged and smoke-checked in staging. will watch metrics and post a short update in #product after 4h.
